text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sounds of Earth's three-year journey
in pursuit of the ultimate session
had finally reached its finale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, this is merely the beginning of a brand-new movement for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The music continues.
...It goes on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those upon this earth
who listen to it, love it, play it, and seek it—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that song...
It's from Sounds of Earth's album, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the one with the "Japanese Derby" motif.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man... every time I hear it, it brings it all back...
That legendary race, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. Earth's music really brings the
scenery to life, it's amazing.
Though I'm more of an "Arima Kinen" fan~.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's unfair.
The Arima Kinen song is practically in the Hall of Fame.

text_block_list.name: Music-Loving Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, so this is the racecourse...!
So, are there races going on already?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Race 3 should be running right about now.
Still, man, you sure got interested in racing all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Music-Loving Young Man
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's so amazing!
This girl Sounds of Earth's album!
Every single track on it is utterly mind-blowing!!

text_block_list.name: Music-Loving Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Since every single one is modeled after races she's run...
of course that's gonna pique your interest!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. That's some crazy enthusiasm...
Well, as someone who loves racing, I'm just
happy you're interested in it, no matter the reason—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Now, let us play our melody today!
The greatest race of all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Popular as always, I see.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Cheval...!
Your sound today is truly magnificent as well...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you...
I've run with Earth-san many times now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed.
And no matter how many times we run, every race with you
is always so thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's make it resound today as well—the harmony of our souls!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'd gladly welcome it.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
âSeriously, Earth, you never change.
Releasing albums, running in tons of races, doing all these amazing things all the time, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Always cheerful, never forgetting the music.
And teaching everyone
just how fun racing can be—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
That's the representative of our generation,
possessor of the one and only golden melody—
Sounds of Earth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Those who love racing continue to tell the tale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Emotion, fervor, legendary battles.
Carried by the sound of galloping stars racing across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if speaking of the music I adore—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, it really is a wonderful location.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can clearly see the earth and the sky.
I can perceive the contours of the world.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer,
shall we make this the venue for our memorable debut performance?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Still, to think that... as I kept running, the musical score would just keep getting longer and longer.
choice_data_list: That's just how many incredible races there were.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, without a doubt.
Every single one was a race worthy of being passed down through generations—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, building things up anew like this...
and letting time pass...――”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Being able to play music with you like this...
...is more delightful than anything else.
choice_data_list: (I ready my violin to match Earth.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ……It's beginning to resonate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Music that poured in everything
from both her and myself up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And once again, it begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our music together starts again from here...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Become the sound of the world.
